talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 6 solo PCPs winding down in New Mexico, several with no local backup — drive-time gap risk.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~1,156 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Chaves County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 5 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~27,600 patients across 23 at-risk practices statewide.
